upsert.title: Global Virtual Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: Online student hackathon with Junior and Senior divisions; teams build a project and defend it on camera.
upsert.eligibility: Students aged 14 to 18 from any school worldwide, teams of 2 to 4; needs a supervising teacher's confirmation and signed parent or guardian consent for every member.

prize.description: US$3,000 total: per division (Junior, Senior) US$1,000 first prize plus two US$250 runner-up prizes.

upsert.title: Misconception Detection in K-12 Student Workings (Kaggle)
upsert.summary: Kaggle machine-learning competition to teach AI to diagnose student misconceptions in handwritten maths.
upsert.eligibility: Open to the global machine learning community via Kaggle; winning teams must publish their full solution under an open licence. Detailed rules not verified on the Kaggle page.

prize.description: US$6,000 total: US$3,000 first, US$2,000 second, US$1,000 third.

upsert.title: UBC 2026 Hackathon (University Blockchain Conference)
upsert.summary: Online hackathon (13 to 20 Nov) with Agentic Payments & AI, DeFi & Onchain Apps and Consumer Apps tracks plus sponsor bounties; top teams pitch at the finals at UT Austin on 21 Nov.
upsert.eligibility: Solo or team entries; open to experienced developers and first-timers. Country restrictions and payout form not verified.

prize.description: More than US$23,000 across main prizes and bounties: US$12,000 for three tracks (US$2,000 / US$1,250 / US$750 per track), plus Gemini, Solana, Arc and QuickNode bounties. Whether paid as cash or tokens is not stated.

upsert.title: IXH26 Italian XRPL Hackathon
upsert.summary: In-person hackathon at the University of Bari, 20 to 21 Nov 2026, with tracks in advanced blockchain cryptography, XRPL applications and tokenisation.
upsert.eligibility: Teams of 3 to 8; one of three tracks. Eligible students may get accommodation and travel support. Places limited; registration via Luma.

prize.description: EUR 12,000 total: per track EUR 2,000 first, EUR 1,200 second, EUR 800 third.
